description_en: Queries the details of a video editing and producing job, including the task status, timeline, template, and data
description_zh: 获取剪辑合成作业的详细信息，包括剪辑合成任务的任务状态、时间线、模板及数据等
name: GetMediaProducingJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the video editing and producing job
parameters.name: job_id

ClipsParam.description_en: The template parameters corresponding to the video editing and producing job
ClipsParam.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的模板参数

Code.description_en:
The error code of the video editing and producing job.
<notice>Pay attention to this field when the job fails.></notice>
Code.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业错误码
<notice>作业失败时关注该字段></notice>

CompleteTime.description_en:
The time when the video editing and producing job was completed. The time is displayed in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
CompleteTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业完成时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the video editing and producing job was created. The time is displayed in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
CreateTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业创建时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

Duration.description_en:
The duration of the produced media.
<notice>This field has a value only when the producing task is successful and the output type is audio or video.></notice>
Duration.description_zh:
输出成品的时长
<notice>当合成任务成功且输出成品的类型为音视频时，该字段有值。></notice>

JobId.description_en: The ID of the video editing and producing job

MediaId.description_en: The resource ID of the produced media

MediaURL.description_en: The URL of the resource file for the produced media

Message.description_en:
The error message of the video editing and producing job.

<notice>Pay attention to this field when the job fails.></notice>
Message.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业错误信息

<notice>作业失败时关注该字段></notice>
Message.example: The specified "Width_Height" has exceeded maximum value.

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The time when the video editing and producing job was modified. The time is displayed in UTC.

Format: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业修改时间，格式为utc时间。

格式为："YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss'Z'"

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the cloud editing project

Status.description_en:
The status of the video editing and producing job. Valid values:

Init: initial state
Queuing: queuing
Processing: processing
Success: successful
Failed: failed
Status.description_zh:
剪辑合成作业状态，取值可能为如下值：

Init （初始状态）
Queuing（排队中）
Processing（处理中）
Success（成功）
Failed（失败）

SubJobMaterials.description_en: The material information used by the subtask, such as the voiceover script and title. This field is returned when the editing task is a subtask of a batch intelligent one-click video producing task
SubJobMaterials.description_zh: 当该剪辑任务是批量智能一键成片的子任务，返回子任务用到的口播文案、标题等素材信息
SubJobMaterials.example: {"Title": "title", "SpeechText": "Batch intelligent one-click into a piece of oral copy"}

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the template corresponding to the video editing and producing job
TemplateId.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的模板Id

Timeline.description_en: The timeline corresponding to the video editing and producing job
Timeline.description_zh: 剪辑合成作业对应的时间线

UserData.description_en: The custom user settings in JSON format

VodMediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset in ApsaraVideo VOD. If the produced media of the editing task is output to ApsaraVideo VOD, the produced media is registered as a media asset in ApsaraVideo VOD, and this field indicates the ID of the media asset
VodMediaId.description_zh: 如果剪辑任务的成片输出到VOD，成片会注册成一个VOD的媒资，vodMediaId 即该媒资在VOD的媒资ID
